class.name: litegrip_ros2_control/LitegripSystem
class.description:
The ros2_control hardware interface for the LiteGrip gripper (single joint).
It does not access CAN directly: commands and state are exchanged with the Python daemon (litegrip_hw_daemon, which owns can0 exclusively and talks to the LiteGrip SDK) over seqlock-protected shared memory, so read()/write() are a lock-free memcpy plus one unit conversion and no Python sits in the real-time loop.
Interface surface: command exposes position only (DM MIT position control underneath); state exposes position/velocity/effort, matching the arm joints.
